formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Switch.terminal_fraction_exact {n : ℕ} (hmu : 0 < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n) :
    (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Switch.terminalDepth n : ℝ) / _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.blockCount (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n) = _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Parameters.terminalFraction := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
At any natural input size $n$ with positive executable inner size $\mu(n)$, let $d_{\mathrm{term}}(n)$ be the terminal depth and $J(n)$ the block count. Then $$\frac{d_{\mathrm{term}}(n)}{J(n)}=\tau,$$ where $\tau=13/20$ is the fixed terminal fraction.

Connects the integer executable depth to the exact analytic switching parameter. This is a supporting lemma in the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
